kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: web

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:

      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: web:dev
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

  name: web
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
